evidence.summary: EIA reported a 0.6m-barrel crude draw, 0.8m gasoline build and 1.6m distillate build; distillate inventories remained 13% below their five-year average.
Orlen contracted 16 additional crude deliveries, about 16m barrels, to cover disrupted Saudi supply for September and October.

sources.title: Poland's Orlen buys 16 extra crude cargoes amid Saudi disruption

evidence.summary: Alternative sourcing mitigates an acute crude shortage but is logistical substitution, not Saudi pipeline restoration or refined-fuel normalization.
